objective: Strengthen meaningful behavioral discrimination in cashflow_engine where C42.21 showed 97.6% coverage but only 29.1% mutation score (122/172 survivors).
strategic_constraint: Not a score-optimization exercise. Strengthen genuine financial-behavior protection; classify (not chase) equivalent/unreachable mutants.
approach: Existing 4 property tests check structural invariants only. Added 10 deterministic example-based behavioral tests (in tests/properties/cashflow, the mutation-selected path) pinning precise paise-level financial semantics: cash_surplus, true_savings, liability_adjusted_savings, net_worth_impact, fee estimate, credit_funded, credit_dependency_ratio, effective_liquidity_cost_annualized, and month_classification boundary semantics.

class_C_unreachable_defensive_get_defaul.rationale: Mutation only changes behavior when the input key is ABSENT. The engine contract guarantees callers always supply income_paise/expense_paise/event keys. Tests supplying missing keys would validate defensive defaults, not domain behavior -> explicitly not pursued (anti-gaming control).

class_C_unreachable_wrong_literal.rationale: Mutation substitutes a string literal that no caller ever produces (event_type is one of the known constants; result keys are fixed). Unreachable under the contract.

examples: and event_amount >= 0 (fee block) -> fee still max(0,0)=0 at boundary
if cash_surplus > 1 (first branch) -> else branch still yields SURPLUS
elif cash_surplus <= 0 or not has_credit_events -> first branch already catches surplus+no-credit, outcome identical
total_fees = max(1, fee_estimate) only differs at fee_estimate==0 (1 paise, below financial materiality)
class_B_equivalent_boundary.rationale: Mutant changes an expression but the observable financial result is identical for all valid-domain inputs (boundary coincidences and the else-branch fallback absorb the change). Mathematically equivalent within the contract.

regression.mypy_strict: passed after dict type annotation fix

conclusion: Meaningful behavioral protection substantially increased (78 genuine arithmetic/invariant mutants now killed). Remaining 44 survivors are all Class B (equivalent) or Class C (unreachable defensive/literal) — none represent a genuine undetected financial-behavior gap. No production logic changed.

exit_gate.coverage_delta_recorded: test count +10 behavioral; line coverage already ~97.6%
